progress.boundary: Training-state round trips, forced early generations and short native runtime checks. Not exact mid-lap/GPU continuation, cryptographic authentication or learning-convergence evidence.

learning.boundary: Two naturally finished generations per V4/V5 and circuit, 16 cars, one seed. Censored means the wall-time guard ended the observation, never a forced training completion. Throughput observed from snapshots may undercount inter-generation tails. Does not establish long-run convergence or superiority.

boundary: Real final Windows portable GPU/CPU 100-agent matrices, all four models, all real circuits; progress files and natural V4/V5 generation checks. Capacity/runtime is not convergence. Two cold generations/one seed do not prove superiority; observed throughput is approximate. Installer built, not installed. Older artifacts and saves preserved.
